title: Agentic Graph Specification (AGS) 1.0
description: Canonical data model for an Agentic Graph: a directed acyclic graph whose nodes are agentic loops (tasks) and whose edges are control-flow dependencies. The same document may be written in JSON or YAML; this schema is the single normative shape for both.

^x-.$comment: Reserved for implementation-specific extensions. Harnesses MUST preserve and MAY ignore.

ags_version.description: Version of the Agentic Graph Specification this document targets. MAJOR.MINOR only.

kind.description: Document discriminator. Reserved so future AGS document kinds can share the media type.

id.description: Stable, globally meaningful identifier for this graph (slug or reverse-DNS).

objective.description: The single top-level goal the whole graph exists to accomplish, in one paragraph.

version.description: Author-controlled semantic version of THIS document (independent of ags_version).

requires_conformance.description: Minimum AGS conformance level a harness must implement to run this graph.

params.description: Typed invocation surface. Values are supplied by the caller at run time and are readable as params.<name>.

context.description: Shared, read-only background knowledge available to every node as context.<key>. Free-form JSON values.

attachments.description: Shared reference material (files, URLs) that nodes may pull into their context.

secrets.description: Names of secrets the graph expects the harness to provide. Secret VALUES never appear in a graph document and MUST NOT be referenced from expressions.

entrypoints.description: Node ids that become ready when the run starts.

defaults.description: Node-level defaults shallow-merged into every node that does not set the corresponding block.

nodes.description: Map of node id to node definition. Keys are the node ids; this guarantees id uniqueness.

edges.description: Explicit control-flow edges. Combined with the desugaring of every node's depends_on to form the effective edge set.

subgraphs.description: Named, reusable graph fragments local to this document, referenced by subgraph nodes via subgraph.use.

outputs.description: Deliverables of the whole graph, bound from node outputs.

success.description: Acceptance criteria for the graph as a whole, evaluated after all reachable nodes reach a terminal state.

binding_name.description: Identifier usable as a dotted path segment in an AGX expression.

expression.description: An AGX expression. The entire string is the expression; no ${{ }} wrapper. See docs/expressions.md.

template.description: Text that may embed AGX expressions using ${{ ... }} interpolation.

value_type.description: Logical type of an input, output, or parameter.

schema.description: Inline JSON Schema constraining the value.

from.description: AGX expression producing the value, e.g. nodes.design.outputs.design_doc.

template.description: Alternative to `from`: interpolated text. Mutually exclusive with `from` and `value`.

value.description: Literal value. Mutually exclusive with `from` and `template`.

default.description: Used when the resolved value is absent and required is false.

redact.description: Harness SHOULD omit this value from logs, traces, and run records.

required.description: If true, the node cannot succeed unless this output is produced.

path_hint.description: Suggested workspace-relative location for file/artifact outputs.

intelligence.description: Normalized capability demand for the node, used by a harness to route to an appropriately powerful model.

tier.description: Named capability tier. Ordered minimal < standard < advanced < frontier.

level.description: Numeric mirror of tier: 1=minimal, 2=standard, 3=advanced, 4=frontier. MUST agree with tier when both are present.

hints.description: Non-ordered routing hints. Advisory: a harness MAY use them to pick among models that already satisfy the tier.

min_context_tokens.description: Hard floor on usable context window. A harness MUST NOT route to a model below this.

allow_downgrade.description: If true, a harness that cannot satisfy the tier MAY route to the closest lower tier instead of failing.

escalate_to.description: Tier to route to on retry after a failure. MUST be >= tier.

rationale.description: Why this node demands this tier. Strongly recommended for advanced/frontier.

requirements.description: Capabilities the node needs before it can run. A harness MUST refuse to start a node whose non-optional requirements it cannot satisfy.

tools.description: Logical tool capabilities, not vendor tool names.

skills.description: Named agent skills/playbooks the node expects to be loaded.

environment.description: Environment variable names the node may read. Only declared names are visible as env.<name>.

secrets.description: Names from the graph-level secrets list that must be injected into this node's execution environment.

network.description: restricted means only hosts implied by declared permissions.

permission.description: Structured permission of the form scope:action[:target], e.g. fs:write:src/**, net:fetch:https://api.github.com, shell:exec:pytest*, git:commit.

constraints.description: Per-node resource and determinism envelope. A harness at conformance level 2+ MUST enforce every limit it understands.

max_agent_steps.description: Maximum iterations of the agentic loop inside this single node.

determinism.description: strict: same inputs must yield byte-identical outputs (temperature 0 and a seed are implied). reproducible: same inputs should yield equivalent outputs. relaxed: no guarantee.

isolation.description: Execution environment isolation for side-effecting work.

concurrency_group.description: Nodes sharing a group never run concurrently.

deadline.description: Absolute wall-clock deadline for this node.

max_node_executions.description: Runaway guard: total node executions across the run, including retries and loop iterations.

on_expression_error.description: fail: an expression evaluation error fails the run. false: the expression is treated as false and a diagnostic is recorded.

on_node_failure.description: halt: stop the whole run. isolate: skip only the failed node's dependents. continue: also attempt dependents whose join permits it.

on_unknown_field.description: Behavior for non x- prefixed fields the harness does not recognize.

checkpointing.description: How often the harness persists run state so a run can be resumed.

record_run.description: Emit an AGS Run Record conforming to agentic-graph-run-1.0.schema.json.

max_attempts.description: Total attempts including the first. 1 means no retry.

feedback.description: What the harness injects into the retry attempt's context.

escalate_intelligence.description: On each retry, route using intelligence.escalate_to if set, otherwise the next higher tier.

strategy.description: alternate_node: run `node` instead. degrade_outputs: accept the partial outputs listed in `outputs`. relax_criteria: re-evaluate with `criteria` demoted to advisory. human_takeover: hand the node to a person. skip: mark the node skipped and continue.

to.description: supervisor means the harness's own planner/orchestrator agent.

failure_policy.description: What happens when a node attempt does not succeed.

fallback.description: Ordered fallbacks attempted after retries are exhausted.

on_exhausted.description: Terminal disposition once retries and fallbacks are exhausted.

compensation.description: Node to run to undo this node's side effects when the run halts after it succeeded.

mode.description: approve: blocking yes/no. review: blocking, may edit outputs. input: blocking, supplies values. notify: non-blocking.

collect.description: For mode=input: values to collect, keyed by name.

criterion.description: One acceptance criterion. Every criterion carries a human-readable description; machine-checkable kinds also carry an executable check.

description.description: Human-readable statement of what must be true. Required for every criterion, including machine-checkable ones.

severity.description: advisory criteria are evaluated and recorded but never gate progression.

run.description: kind=command: the command line to execute.

expect_stdout_matches.description: kind=command: regular expression the stdout must match.

output.description: kind=artifact_present|json_schema|regex: the declared output this criterion inspects.

schema_ref.description: kind=json_schema: URI or workspace path to a JSON Schema.

target.description: kind=regex: expression producing the text to match. Defaults to the value of `output`.

negate.description: kind=regex: pass when the pattern does NOT match.

expr.description: kind=expression: must evaluate to boolean true.

rubric.description: kind=llm_judge: what the judge should assess, in prose.

samples.description: kind=llm_judge: independent judgements to take; the median score is used.

inputs.description: kind=llm_judge: material to place in front of the judge.

prompt.description: kind=human: what the reviewer is asked to confirm.

check.description: kind=external: name of a harness-registered checker.

params.description: kind=external: arguments passed to the checker.

summary.description: One-sentence human definition of done. Strongly recommended.

evaluation_order.description: cheapest_first lets a harness short-circuit expensive judges after a cheap criterion already failed.

mode.description: while: test `condition` BEFORE each iteration. until: run an iteration, then test `condition` and stop when true. repeat: run exactly max_iterations times.

max_iterations.description: Hard bound. Always required; there are no unbounded loops in AGS.

use.description: Name of a fragment in graph.subgraphs to use as the body.

carry.description: Maps a body output name to the body input name it feeds on the next iteration.

collect.description: Maps a node output name to an expression evaluated in the final iteration's scope.

over.description: Expression producing an array to fan out over.

as.description: Binding name for the current element inside the body scope.

max_items.description: Hard bound on fan-out width. Always required.

collect.description: Maps a node output name to an expression evaluated per item; results are gathered into an array in input order.

use.description: Name of a fragment declared in graph.subgraphs.

uri.description: Workspace-relative path or absolute URI of another AGS document.

integrity.description: Subresource-integrity style digest. REQUIRED by strict harnesses for non-local URIs.

params.description: Values bound to the child graph's params, as AGX expressions evaluated in the parent scope.

context.description: Additional context entries merged into the child scope.

outputs_from.description: Maps this node's output names to expressions evaluated in the child graph's final scope.

on_reject.description: route means outgoing conditional edges decide, using gate.decision.

question.description: What the decision node must determine. Omit for purely deterministic decisions.

evaluator.description: agent: a model produces the branch label. expression: the first branch whose `when` is true is selected, with no model call.

branches.description: Enumerated, mutually exclusive outcomes. The selected label is exposed as nodes.<id>.outputs.decision.

graph_fragment.description: A self-contained set of nodes and edges. Used for loop bodies, map bodies, and inline subgraphs. Node ids are scoped to the fragment.

kind.description: sequence: taken when `from` succeeds. conditional: taken when `from` succeeds AND `when` is true. on_failure: taken when `from` reaches a failed terminal state.

when.description: Guard expression. REQUIRED for kind=conditional; optional for on_failure; forbidden for sequence.

label.description: Human-readable edge label, useful for rendering.

carries.description: Documentation-only hint listing which outputs of `from` the `to` node consumes. Data flow is authoritative in inputs.*.from.

type.description: task: an agentic loop. decision: produces a branch label. gate: a human checkpoint. loop: bounded iteration over a body fragment. map: bounded fan-out over a collection. subgraph: runs another graph.

description.description: Precise statement of what the node must accomplish, written as an instruction to the agent that will run it.

rationale.description: Why this node exists in the decomposition.

instructions.description: Optional longer-form guidance appended to `description` when building the node's prompt.

depends_on.description: Shorthand for a sequence edge from each listed node to this one.

join.description: How multiple incoming edges combine into readiness.

when.description: Node-level guard. If present and false at readiness time, the node becomes skipped without running.

estimate.description: Non-binding planning estimates. Useful for scheduling and for showing a user what a graph will cost.

allOf.$comment: Only task, decision, loop, map and subgraph nodes consume model capacity; a gate never does.
